raw_snippet: In consideration for the Non-Default and Default warrants, NVIDIA agreed to guarantee up to $860.3 million of our obligations under a lease agreement for a facility in Ward County, Texas
note: Nvidia -> Nscale guarantee of Nscale's Ward County, Texas data-center lease (first five years), signed 14 Oct 2025; Nscale paid with warrants and a $470M escrow. Nscale Form S-1. Nvidia's Q3 FY26 10-Q showed the same $860M guarantee without naming the partner.
